places.raw_name: the little knoll where the buzzards swarmed
places.name: Knoll where Wilbarger's men were killed
places.note: The pursuers bury the scavenged remains of Wilbarger's man Chick and a boy; Deets reads Jake's track among the thieves'.
places.location_hint: open plains on the trail of Wilbarger's stolen horses, a few hours' ride before the burned settlers; the drive is somewhere south of Kansas, near the Territory

places.raw_name: where the dead settlers were hanging
places.name: Burned settlers' hanging site
places.note: Two farmers found shot, hanged and burned; the party cuts them down and buries them together.
places.location_hint: on the plains a few hours further along the horsethieves' trail from the knoll, a few hours short of the creek camp

places.name: Suggs camp creek
places.note: Steep-banked creek with trees where the Suggs gang camps after killing a medicine-show drummer; the outfit captures and hangs them, Jake included, and buries Jake on the slope.
places.location_hint: steep-banked creek on rolling prairie with a stand of trees, along the horsethieves' trail; the cattle herd lies somewhere to the west; region between the Territory and Kansas

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Jake says he only joined the Suggses to reach Kansas safely; Eddie recalls Dan's boast that no Kansas man could take him.

places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: Jake claims he fell in with the gang just to get through the Territory without being scalped.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Jake won some eight hundred dollars at poker there, which he leaves to his old companions.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Call guesses the murdered medicine-show man was bound there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus muses that without the drive Jake might still be there playing cards with Wanz.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Pursuit party with Wilbarger's horses
groups.hint: driving the recovered horses west across the prairie at night toward where the herd should be
